reason: The absence of a relapse qualifier in the national osteosarcoma listing does not establish the affirmative wording whether or not it has returned. Preserve the listed indication and require individual suitability review instead.
before_paragraph: This treatment is used for Ewing sarcoma that has returned and for osteosarcoma, whether or not it has returned. National guidance gives no numerical age limit. Etoposide use for these diagnoses is unlicensed in Ireland; your team must explain this, document your consent and follow the hospital’s medicines policies.
after_paragraph: National guidance lists this treatment for Ewing sarcoma that has returned, and also for osteosarcoma. Your team will confirm whether it is suitable for your diagnosis and previous treatment. The regimen guidance gives no numerical age limit. Etoposide use for these diagnoses is unlicensed in Ireland; your team must explain this, document your consent and follow the hospital’s medicines policies.
retained_boundaries: Osteosarcoma is separately listed, without adding an affirmative all-disease-stage interpretation
Irish unlicensed etoposide use and documented local discussion/governance
